title: VHLab cells
description: dev's VHLab ROI files (.mat, as the VH lab's analyzetpstack saves them): cellstructs, each cell's outline xi and yi (1-based x and y), read as dev's dataconvert.roi.vhlab reads them: Polygon ROIs, the pixels whose centre is inside, in a 512 x 512 image. Read as the module's ROI document (imageSize and rois of id, area, center and 0-based [row, column] pixels), so the ROIs can be viewed, curated and have their signals extracted. Read only.
